mapper.select: SELECT version, CAST(config_json AS CHAR) config_json FROM detection_policy WHERE policy_type=#{type} AND status='active'

SELECT ir.id inference_request_id, r.id record_id, r.asset_id, r.event_time, ir.model_version_id, mv.model_key, mv.version model_version, LOWER(mv.artifact_sha256) artifact_sha256, ir.contract_version, ir.contract_sha256, ir.attack_probability, ir.decision_threshold, ir.threshold_policy_version FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=ir.model_version_id WHERE r.batch_id=#{batchId} AND ir.status='succeeded' AND ir.binary_label='Attack' ORDER BY r.id
SELECT alert_key FROM detection_alert WHERE alert_key IN #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detection_alert (alert_key, ingest_record_id, inference_request_id, model_version_id, contract_version, contract_sha256, detection_rule_id, alert_type, severity, severity_policy_version, score, threshold_version, basis_json, status, detected_at) VALUES (#{alertKey}, #{ingestRecordId}, #{inferenceRequestId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{modelVersionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{contractVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contractSha256,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{detectionRuleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{alertType}, #{severity}, #{severityPolicyVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{score,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{thresholdVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{basisJson} AS JSON), 'new', #{detectedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM detection_alert WHERE alert_key=#{alertKey}

SELECT id, rule_key, version, CAST(scope_json AS CHAR) scope_json, CAST(condition_json AS CHAR) condition_json, severity FROM detection_rule WHERE status='active' AND approved_by IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT feature_contract_version FROM ingest_batch WHERE id=#{batchId}
SELECT id, asset_key, criticality FROM asset WHERE id=#{assetId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM security_event WHERE correlation_key=#{correlationKey} AND status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'contained') AND last_seen_at >= #{from} AND first_seen_at <= #{to} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_event (event_key, title, category, severity, status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, correlation_key, correlation_policy_version) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{title}, 'network', #{severity}, 'open', #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{correlationKey}, #{correlationPolicyVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM security_event WHERE event_key=#{eventKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE security_event SET first_seen_at=LEAST(first_seen_at, #{seenAt}), last_seen_at=GREATEST(last_seen_at, #{seenAt}), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_alert_link (event_id, alert_id, link_type) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{alertId}, 'correlated')
INSERT INTO event_asset_link (event_id, asset_id, relation_type, evidence_count) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{assetId}, 'affected', 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_count=evidence_count+1

INSERT INTO event_timeline (event_id, occurred_at, entry_type, actor_type, actor_id, summary, evidence_ref, details_json) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{occurredAt}, 'alert_correlated', 'system', 'detection', #{summary}, #{evidenceRef}, CAST(#{detailsJson} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT da.severity FROM event_alert_link eal JOIN detection_alert da ON da.id=eal.alert_id WHERE eal.event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.sql: id, rule_key, version, CAST(scope_json AS CHAR) scope_json, CAST(condition_json AS CHAR) condition_json, severity, status, requested_by, approved_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM detection_rule ORDER BY rule_key, id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT FROM detection_rule WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detection_rule (rule_key, version, scope_json, condition_json, severity, status, requested_by) VALUES (#{ruleKey}, #{version}, CAST(#{scopeJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{conditionJson} AS JSON), #{severity}, 'pending', #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM detection_rule WHERE rule_key=#{ruleKey} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE detection_rule SET status='active', approved_by=#{approvedBy}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending' AND (requested_by IS NULL OR requested_by <> #{approvedBy})
UPDATE detection_rule SET status='retired', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE rule_key=#{ruleKey} AND status='active' AND id <> #{exceptId}
UPDATE detection_rule SET status='retired', updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
UPDATE security_event SET severity=#{severity}, risk_score=#{riskScore}, risk_rule_version=#{riskVersion}, risk_basis_json=CAST(#{basisJson} AS JSON), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{eventId}
